profileEvidence.summary: Determined and effective in a pack, the historical Levesque hound specialised in roe deer. Rogatien Levesque’s Vioreau hounds worked as a closely matched team and could go out as often as four times a week. At La Poterie, north of Nantes, he developed this robust black-and-white population from hunting stock already kept by his family.
